speaker: NARRATOR
tts_text: Hollis asks it how its day is going. It looks like a piece of furniture.

speaker: NARRATOR
tts_text: It scrapes a few inches and settles. It preferred the old spot.

speaker: NARRATOR
tts_text: Hollis sits, stands, and sits again. It does not solve anything.

speaker: NARRATOR
tts_text: Hollis cannot take a door. He has considered it.

speaker: NARRATOR
tts_text: Hollis pushes. The door was not designed to be pushed by an employee.

speaker: NARRATOR
tts_text: It does not open the way Hollis wants. It opens like a bureaucracy: slowly, and on a different day.

speaker: NARRATOR
tts_text: Hollis talks to the door. A cat on the other side does not answer.

speaker: NARRATOR
tts_text: Hollis pulls. The door is about as excited as he is.

speaker: NARRATOR
tts_text: Hollis uses the door to go in and out. This does not count as a puzzle.

speaker: NARRATOR
tts_text: Hollis lines up the ITEM with the THING, and then notices a cat watching. He lowers the ITEM.

speaker: NARRATOR
tts_text: The ITEM and the THING have no business together. HR would need a form for that.

speaker: NARRATOR
tts_text: Hollis holds up the ITEM. The THING is unmoved. The narrator is a little impressed.

speaker: NARRATOR
tts_text: Hollis thinks about using the ITEM on the THING. The THING has not done anything to deserve it.

speaker: NARRATOR
tts_text: That is not how the ITEM works. That is not how the THING works. That is not how anything works.
